name: Burst
description: Clicking throws a spray of small bits out of the pointer. They fan out from the press point, arc over under gravity and fade as they fall, and each button throws its own colour. Releasing the button throws a smaller, quicker spray after it. Nothing is drawn while the pointer is only moving.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Count
parameters.description: How many bits a press throws. Set it to 0 to turn the pack off

parameters.name: Launch speed
parameters.description: How fast a bit leaves the press point (px per second)

parameters.name: Gravity
parameters.description: Downward pull that bends the spray into an arc (px per second squared)

parameters.name: Life
parameters.description: How long a bit lives before it is gone (seconds)

parameters.name: Reach
parameters.description: Furthest a bit may travel from the press point. Launch speed and gravity are scaled down together to stay inside it, and the bit size is taken out of it first where the reach allows (px)

parameters.name: Release spray
parameters.description: How much of a spray the button coming back up throws. Set it to 0 for a press-only spray

parameters.name: Left button
parameters.description: Bit colour for the left button

parameters.name: Right button
parameters.description: Bit colour for the right button

parameters.name: Middle button
parameters.description: Bit colour for the middle button
